subQuestions.questionText: According to Lamarck's theory for evolution, …
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: B (2 marks)
Lamarck proposed that organisms evolve by adapting to their environment through use and disuse of structures, and that acquired characteristics are inherited.

options.B: organisms evolve because they adapt to their environment.
options.D: environmental changes have no influence on species diversity.

subQuestions.questionText: The genotype for a specific characteristic …
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: C (2 marks)
A genotype for a specific characteristic is the genetic composition of a gene pair (two alleles). It is not the physical appearance (that is the phenotype) and it does not contain whole chromosomes.

options.B: is the physical appearance of an individual.
options.C: is the composition of a gene pair.

options.C: small cranium, a prognathous jaw and large canines.
options.D: large cranium, a prognathous jaw and small canines.

subQuestions.questionText:
The statements below describe the steps in the process of cloning an animal.
(i) The embryo is implanted into the uterus of an adult female for development.
(ii) The nucleus from a somatic cell of the donor is extracted.
(iii) The nucleus from the somatic cell is inserted into the ovum.
(iv) The nucleus from the ovum of another individual is removed.
(v) The ovum with the new nucleus is given an electric shock to stimulate cell division and the formation of the embryo.

Which combination shows the CORRECT order of the steps?
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: A (2 marks)
Correct cloning sequence: (ii) extract donor somatic-cell nucleus → (iv) remove ovum nucleus → (iii) insert somatic nucleus into ovum → (v) stimulate division → (i) implant embryo into uterus.

It is hypothesised that all continents were once one large continent called Pangaea and that they separated due to continental drift. This is evidence that the family Proteaceae … (Refer to the world map in the question paper.)
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: D (2 marks)
The distribution across continents that were once joined as Pangaea provides biogeographical evidence that Proteaceae arose from a common ancestor before continental drift separated the populations.

options.A: all belong to the same species.
options.B: are equally distributed on all continents.
options.D: arose from a common ancestor when Pangaea separated.

subQuestions.questionText:
The following are characteristics of a group of animals:
(i) Able to interbreed
(ii) Occupy the same habitat
(iii) Produce infertile offspring
(iv) Belong to the same species

Which combination CORRECTLY represents a population?
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: B (2 marks)
A population is a group of organisms of the same species (iv) that occupy the same habitat (ii) and are able to interbreed (i). Producing infertile offspring (iii) would mean they are not the same species.

subQuestions.questionText: During Anaphase II of meiosis, the two chromatids of a chromosome are pulled apart, each moving towards opposite poles at a rate of 1 micrometre per second. The distance, in micrometres, between the chromatids after 20 seconds is …
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: D (2 marks)
Each chromatid moves at 1 µm/s for 20 s = 20 µm. Since both chromatids move in opposite directions, the total distance between them = 20 + 20 = 40 µm.

subQuestions.questionText:
Which ONE of the following indicates the type of variation for each of the human characteristics given?

     Height          | Skin colour    | Ear lobe types
A  discontinuous | continuous     | discontinuous
B  continuous    | continuous     | discontinuous
C  discontinuous | discontinuous  | continuous
D  discontinuous | continuous     | continuous
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: B (2 marks)
Height is continuous variation (range of values), skin colour is continuous variation (range of shades), and ear lobe types (attached/unattached) is discontinuous variation (distinct categories).

B: principle of independent assortment

None ✓✓ (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText:
Indicate whether the description applies to A only, B only, both A and B, or none.

Description: Reproductive isolating mechanism in species

B: infertile offspring
subQuestions.memoText:
B only ✓✓ (2 marks)
Producing infertile offspring is a reproductive isolating mechanism. Breeding in the SAME season would not isolate species — different breeding seasons would.

subQuestions.questionText: Describe the process of speciation through geographic isolation.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 7 of:
- If a population of a single species becomes separated by a geographical barrier ✓ (sea, river, mountain, lake)
- then the population splits into two ✓
- There is now no gene flow between the two populations ✓
- Since each population may be exposed to different environmental conditions / the selection pressure may be different ✓
- natural selection occurs independently in each of the two populations ✓
- such that the individuals of the two populations become (very) different from each other ✓
- genotypically and phenotypically ✓
- Even if the two populations were to mix again ✓
- they will not be able to interbreed ✓
- The two populations are now different species ✓
(7 marks)
